detail:
EVIDENCE: SCAN-1032 detail: "csp.violation script-src eval reported on /people/<handle> and /create-a-space"; /admin/qr threw React #441 without UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET (lib/qr/node-code.ts refuses to sign); .env.example:139 lists it.

WHY IT MATTERS: If the secret is missing in prod, QR signing and unsubscribe links fail; eval violation may hide a dependency needing unsafe-eval.

FIX DIRECTION: Owner confirms the Vercel var (name only); agent finds the eval source with a CSP report-only run.
